H1.main_vs_supplement: Main text: 2-3 sentences in manuscript/main.tex lines 252-306. Supplement: full S1-S7 model table, lambda profile likelihood, comparator metadata summary (32 unique GTDB/MGnify accessions), and dual caller bounds.
supported_claims: Across all n = 237 dereplicated Rub' al-Khali Thermoplasmatota species representatives (185 c__SW-10-69-26, 51 c__E2, 1 c__Thermoplasmata) on the 1,914-tip GTDB-Tk r232 ar53 tree, per-genome dark fraction exhibits strong residual phylogenetic covariance under Pagel's lambda PGLS (lambda_ML = 0.915784, 95% profile-likelihood CI [0.846303, 0.957823], LRT vs lambda = 0: 2 Delta ell = 229.5585, p = 7.4411e-52; R^2_GLS = 0.469051, OLS R^2 = 0.495786).

In the primary PGLS model (S1, df = 230) controlling for CheckM2 completeness (-0.000335 +/- 0.000126, p = 8.398044e-3), contamination (-0.000320 +/- 0.000491, p = 5.159032e-1), log10 genome length (+0.115427 +/- 0.018391, p = 1.706357e-9), and log10 N50 (-0.009005 +/- 0.003031, p = 3.284365e-3), dark fraction shows a positive conditional partial association with nearest-relative AAI (+0.001704 +/- 0.000407, t = +4.1847, p = 4.065008e-5) and a negative conditional partial association with RBH coverage (-0.137484 +/- 0.019456, t = -7.0664, p = 1.879206e-11), with consistent signs and significance across S2-S7.
prohibited_claims: Do not interpret lambda_ML = 0.915784 as percent variance explained or proof that vertical lineage history dominates all other explanations.

Do not interpret the conditional AAI slope as a positive marginal relationship, describe N_dark and N_RBH as disjoint core/accessory partitions, or claim proof of horizontal gene transfer, de novo gene birth, or accessory expansion.
Do not describe the 32 unique external GTDB/MGnify reference comparators as cultivated isolates or present 237 pair counts as 237 unique reference genomes.
H1.venue_contribution: Bounds within-Thermoplasmatota dark-fraction variation by accounting for residual phylogenetic covariance and assembly covariates across the 237 species representatives.

supported_claims: Among the 353 multi-species Gate 3 structural dark families passing the primary Tier 1 complete-window gate (173/570 = 30.35% in low-query-TM K with qTM < 0.5; 180/891 = 20.20% in fold-matched QnotK with qTM >= 0.5), flanking KO recurrence exceeds same-contig eligible-position expectations (B = 5,000) within both K (40.4624% [70/173] vs 8.7114% expected, excess +31.7510 percentage points, p = 0.0002) and QnotK (32.2222% [58/180] vs 6.5551% expected, excess +25.6671 percentage points, p = 0.0002).

Conditioned on species breadth, coarse host phylum group, and flanking KO annotation opportunity, low-query-TM (K) and fold-matched (QnotK) families do not show a statistically established difference in neighborhood KO recurrence: Tier 1 Delta_MH(E_fam) = +0.035358 (p = 0.406859) and Delta_MH(C_fam) = +0.053850 (p = 0.259774); Tier 2 (n = 637: 260 K, 377 QnotK) Delta_MH(E_fam) = +0.018391 (p = 0.561844) and Delta_MH(C_fam) = +0.043859 (p = 0.232277); strict 96-pair exact-phylum/tight-length matching raw difference 0.0000 (31.25% vs 31.25%, p = 1.0000) and excess difference -0.005440 (p = 0.922608); multivariable OLS/HC3 beta_is_k = +0.029446 +/- 0.042950 (p = 0.492970) on E_fam and +0.049661 +/- 0.046674 (p = 0.287330) on C_fam.
prohibited_claims: Do not invert K (low whole-query TM-score < 0.5) and QnotK (fold-matched comparator, qTM >= 0.5) or label either group as proven novel folds.

Do not generalize Tier 1 recurrence rates to all 2,838 or 1,461 dark families without stating the 75.84% (1,108/1,461) complete-window attrition and differential survival (30.35% K vs 20.20% QnotK, Fisher p = 1.46e-5).

Do not cite the unadjusted Tier 3 partial-window comparison (p = 0.000458) as evidence of a structural-group effect, or claim that the top-KO mobilome keyword screen proves the absence of mobile genetic elements.
H2.venue_contribution: Demonstrates above-background within-arm flanking KO recurrence among complete-window multi-species families while showing no covariate-adjusted difference between low-query-TM (K) and fold-matched (QnotK) arms.
